Overview

This internship will help the team in variety of ways that may include assisting with the maintenance and improvement of our IT infrastructure, supporting the smooth operation of our systems, and/or assisting with various IT projects. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in various aspects of information technology within a leading financial services and life insurance company. This internship works with supervision, partnering with their manager as needed and updating their Manager on a regular basis. Specific responsibilities associated with this position include: Information Security:- Provides support to business and IT teams on security consulting and information security projects. Assists in security and risk assessments of W&SFG systems, third-party vendors, and user access. Supports members of the Security Access Management (SRM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), and IT Risk Management (ITRM) teams in daily operations, recommending risk mitigations and countermeasures, escalating issues as needed. Software Quality Assurance:- Collaborates with testing, development, and project teams to create and maintain automation scripts and data testing artifacts, ensuring alignment with application testing efforts and Enterprise standards.Project Management Office:- Supports the Project Management Office by collaborating with program managers, project managers, business analysts, and PMO leadership to help manage and deliver strategic projects for Western & Southern Financial Group.Service Management Office: - Provides desk-side technical support and deployment services, interacting with Service Desk and IT teams to resolve hardware, software, and system issues. Assists with on-site and remote problem diagnosis, asset installation, and inventory control. W&S Agency Systems:- Supports the IT Agency Systems Team in updating Agency Systems Applications through the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with IT and business staff to write and test .NET/C#, Visual Studio, Oracle, and SQL Server tools in an Agile/Scrum environment. FWIA / ERG / Finance:- Supports Fort Washington Investment Advisors, Eagle Realty Group, and financial operations by evaluating, implementing, and supporting business applications. Helps business units execute their strategies and achieve W&S's financial goals. Helps develop and enhance operational solutions for business users.Artificial Intelligence & Robotics:- Uses advanced software to automate manual processes, supporting all departments to enhance productivity. Evaluates, implements, and supports business applications, helping business units achieve their strategies and W&S's financial goals.
